entities.summary: Florian Kunz is a former field hockey defender from Germany. He was the captain of the side which won the 2002 Men's Hockey World Cup. He played a total of 228 caps for the national team from 1992 until 2004. Kunz competed for Germany at the 2000 Summer Olympics and 2004 Summer Olympics. Florian Kunz was a athletes & competitors from Leverkusen (b. 1972-02-22, Leverkusen). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
